changelog:
- Initial release of the smart-hardware-reference skill, serving as a comprehensive knowledge base for smart hardware development.
- Provides a structured catalog of 9 domains and 68 task types covering the full lifecycle: market, architecture, hardware, embedded software, ID/structure, prototyping, mass production, operations, and project management.
- Supplies task checklists, structural requirement slots, and exemplary frameworks; all execution is delegated to Universal Task OS (UTOS).
- Features unique dimensions for smart hardware, including hardware-software integration, manufacturing constraints, and compliance/validation (e.g., FCC/CE/SRRC).
- Supports reference-only or full execution modes based on the presence of UTOS, with automatic dependency installation and clear downgrade behavior.
